Mortgage approvals soften as lenders reprice fixed rates
item.description: Brokers report a slower pipeline. A long excerpt follows to check truncation behaviour. Lenders have repriced two- and five-year fixed products following the latest gilt moves, and several brokers say applications have slowed through the second half of the month. Landlord borrowers are said to be the most exposed, with portfolio stress tests tightening across the specialist market and several lenders pulling limited-edition products at short notice. Advisers expect a further round of repricing before the next Monetary Policy Committee meeting, though nobody is prepared to call the direction with confidence given the mixed signals in the most recent inflation print and the unusually wide spread of forecasts now circulating among the major lenders.
